svg.title: V-shaped valley with interlocking spurs
svg.desc: A cross-section of a river in its upper course cutting down by vertical erosion (hydraulic action and abrasion) while freeze-thaw weathering and soil creep wear back the steep sides into a V, and a plan view of the river winding between interlocking spurs.

text.tspan: e.g. upper River Liffey, Co. Wicklow
